## Goal

Real programs live in the page, ratatui apps in WASM, and candidates compared cell by cell.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| TM-02 | Live mode: real program in a PTY rendered with xterm.js, with resize, input and recording to asciicast v3 | I, B | htop, vim and a ratatui demo run live with resize and input; recording replays to identical frames |
| TM-04 | WASM mode: a Ratzilla template for ratatui | B | Ratzilla template builds and runs in the WASM island; frames reported over the bridge |
| TM-05 | A Rust capture crate turns a ratatui TestBackend buffer and scripted keys into frames, with zero cell diff against WASM mode for the same app | M | Capture crate frames equal WASM-mode frames for the template app (zero cell difference) |
| TM-07 | Terminal compare with synchronized playback and cell diff; comments on cell rectangles | B | TerminalCompare synchronized playback and cell diff; comments on cell rectangles resolve after reload |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- the PTY host and `pty` port;
- declared sessions;
- the WebSocket terminal protocol with backpressure;
- the xterm.js 6 WebGL engine as a first-party embed-engine plugin;
- an asciicast v3 tee;
- the Ratzilla template and WASM island with frame reporting;
- `<TerminalCompare>` with synchronized playback, cell diff and cell-rectangle comments.

Design detail for this package:

- PTY host and `pty` port; declared sessions only; WebSocket protocol with backpressure; asciicast v3 tee.
- xterm.js 6 WebGL engine as a first-party embed-engine plugin.
- Ratzilla template and WASM island with frame reporting; zero-cell-difference proof against capture (TM-05).
- `<TerminalCompare>` and cell-rectangle comments.

## Out of scope

- Recorded mode (WP-22)

## Acceptance evidence

- htop, vim and a ratatui demo resize correctly live;
- the recording replays to identical frames;
- zero cell differences between capture and WASM for the template app;
- compare and comments on cells.

Also: `pnpm check` green (from WP-01 on), diff reviewed, evidence matrix rows updated, docs and AGENTS.md current, progress report written after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Browsers cap WebGL contexts: virtualize off-screen terminals.
